term.label: operator

definition.text: A regulatory element of an operon to which activators or repressors bind thereby effecting translation of genes in that operon.

comments: Moved to transcriptional_cis_regulatory_region (SO:0001055) from gene_group_regulatory_region (SO:0000752) on 11 Feb 2021 when SO:0000752 was merged into SO:0001055. See GitHub Issue #529.
